case_classification.short_description: Small DCF (no forecasting, estimates given) with two-stage TV and sensitivity analysis regarding two factors

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This FP&A modeling task is highly complex due to the requirement for an iterative WACC calculation (circular reference loop based on market value of equity), a dynamic two-stage terminal value model that accommodates changing transition years (g1 until end year), and the precise fractional-year discounting required between the Valuation basis date (2025-09-30) and the Valuation date (2026-04-12). An expert modeler would need to reconstruct the Free Cash Flows (deducing Net CapEx and NWC changes from the balance sheet items), set up a robust multi-year projection model up to 2038 to capture all sensitivity ranges, establish the circular WACC formula using Excel's iterative calculation mode, set up a two-dimensional Data Table for the sensitivity combinations, and carefully extract the answers to the 35 specific questions.
